sloka: रामो याहीति सूतम् तम् तिष्ठेति स जनस्तदा ।उभयम् नाशकत्सूतः कर्तुमध्वनि चोदितः ॥२-४०-३२॥
transliteration: rāmo yāhīti sūtam tam tiṣṭheti sa janastadā ।ubhayam nāśakatsūtaḥ kartumadhvani coditaḥ ॥2-40-32॥

translations.english: Urged by Rama to drive fast on the one hand and by the citizens to stay, on the other, the charioteer could do neither on the way.
